subject: Re: POC prompt set & eval dataset - ingestion details
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Chen <alicia.chen@acmehealth.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC prompt set & eval dataset - ingestion details

Hi Alicia / Tom,

Quick follow-up with a few ingestion preferences to make the baseline run smooth: 

1) File format: JSONL preferred for our eval pipeline; CSV is OK if you confirm newline escaping.
2) Minimal fields: prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_response (optional), intent_tag, phi_redacted (yes/no).
3) Naming convention: acme_poc_prompts_v1.csv or acme_poc_prompts_v1.jsonl and acme_poc_logs_v1.jsonl for logs.
4) Bucket access: we can ingest from an Acme-owned S3 bucket; please share bucket name + a read-only IAM role or temporary creds via your secure transfer process.

We'll convert CSV -> JSONL if needed, but tagging fields and redaction flags saves time. Once we ingest, we plan a 48-72 hour turnaround for baseline metrics.

I'll schedule the kickoff review for Tues, Jun 16, 10:00am PT and send the invite.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: poc_eval_template.xlsx (template)

From: Alicia Chen <alicia.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC prompt set & eval dataset - ingestion details

Thanks Marissa  

Tom confirmed he'll own delivery. We'll prepare a JSONL export as requested and include the phi_redacted flag for any rows we've scrubbed. Expect the first 50-row sample in the attached zip; we'll push the full CSV to our S3 by end of day Friday and share details.

A couple quick Qs from security: do you require server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) on the bucket? We have HIPAA controls and would prefer KMS-managed keys.

Best,
Alicia Chen
Director, Clinical AI | Acme Health

Attachments: prompts_and_logs.zip (sample)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Chen <alicia.chen@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 12:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC prompt set & eval dataset - ingestion details

Hi Alicia  

SSE-KMS is fine and aligns with our recommended flow for customer-owned buckets. For provisioning we'll need either: 
- an IAM role ARN with read/object-get permissions we can assume, or
- a set of temporary creds (we prefer the IAM role for security).

On our side we'll: convert CSV -> JSONL if needed, validate required fields, run a quick smoke eval (sanity checks for parse errors, tokenization issues), then run the baseline across our Dedicated sandbox. We'll notify you if we find PHI-marked rows that still contain identifiers.

Aditya
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
